scope: Chrome viewport emulation using the real local App with controlled public player state; no multiplayer room writes. Preview character names and cards are test data.
checks: All 10 combo/SPECIAL/ABSORB skills receive gold-holo finish in hand and on table
Ordinary skills retain their original category colour
Locked Sky Dragon retains the same gold material
Ultimate flame only appears for an affordable, enabled move while choosing; a free ultimate also qualifies
Insufficient energy, all ultimates disabled, locked, dead, and SHOWDOWN states suppress flames
Category tabs and 15 card-details interactions remain clickable under decorations
Horizontal tray/nav scrolling keeps the aura anchored, with no document horizontal overflow
Aura toggles preserve board/table/hand geometry; category and lock changes preserve board/table geometry
App and OS reduced-motion stop foil and flame animation
shortLandscape: 844x390 intentionally permits vertical scrolling. Geometry compared in document coordinates; a folder outside the viewport correctly hides its aura.

animation.method: Normal CSS animations sampled every approximately 200 ms; no fake JS clock.

limitations: Browser viewport emulation, not physical Safari/iPad hardware.
Visual testing uses temporary/free copies to expose all 10 rare finishes without exceeding permanent skill slots.
